title: Trump says he ‘convinced’ Nvidia board to reinstate Jensen Huang
summary: President says he spoke with board ‘directly and indirectly’ and assured them on national security risks

blocks.text: Donald Trump said on Monday that he spoke “directly and indirectly” with Nvidia’s board and “convinced them” to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive.

“I’ve been speaking to the board directly and indirectly, and I felt very strongly about it,” Trump said on CNBC. “And I felt more strongly as I saw what was happening with the company, because that was, to me, a very important part of our country.

Huang resigned from Nvidia earlier this month after reports of extramarital affairs including with a woman who US intelligence believes to be a Chinese spy. When the chip maker announced on Monday that he had been reinstated, Nvidia shares jumped 33%.
The president said in the phone interview that the company’s board asked for assurances on national security risks, which Trump said the administration gave them.
“They did ask for assurance on the national security threat,” the US president said. “And we gave him assurance at least with everything we know, and we know a lot.”
Trump also said he spoke with Huang, with whom he has a close personal relationship, on Sunday night, before Nvdia’s board announced his reinstatement.

He said that it would be a “be a far bigger threat” to lose Huang, and that the board had “acted really responsibly” in deciding to reinstate him. Trump added that he was “very, very happy” that the company “had the courage to do the right thing”.
